isolation_policy: bubblewrap mount namespace: only the workspace, the policy-accepted read allowlist and the opencode runtime exist; the repository, the other arms' results, the earlier sessions and the global opencode configuration (its MCP servers and plugins) are not mounted; plus the opencode v2 permission object (bash denied, edit and write denied, read and external_directory deny-by-default with the explicit allowlist)
limitations: The mount namespace is the filesystem guarantee; the model provider is reachable over the shared network, so a model that was shown a file can still send it away.
sandbox_argv:
One of three reviewers raised this objection against your proposal:
The encode/decode pair multiplies the residual by lambda_p and divides the decoded code by lambda_p, which is algebraically the same as a per-prefix codebook scale: argmin_j ||lambda_p r - c_j|| = argmin_j ||r - c_j/lambda_p||. The "curvature" therefore acts as a single positive gain on a Euclidean quantizer, so the candidate is variable-rate RQ-VAE rather than curved quantization, and no per-node curvature survives as geometry.
with this counterexample, when one was given:
One dimension, prefix p, lambda_p=2, r=0.9, C={1.4, 1.15}: Euclidean assignment picks 1.15 (distances 0.50 vs 0.25) while the scaled assignment picks 1.4 (0.4 vs 0.65), and that scaled outcome is bit-identical to plain Euclidean nearest-code against C/lambda_p={0.70, 0.575} (0.20 vs 0.325 -> 0.70). Second, at c_p=10 the factor 2/(1-10||x||^2) is unbounded and changes sign at ||x||=1/sqrt(10)=0.316, so at ||x||=0.35 encode multiplies the residual by a negative number and decode divides by it; no clamp is specified.
You have ONE bounded revision of the proposal (not of any code): either repair the specification so the objection no longer holds, or state precisely why the objection is wrong. Do not change the mechanism to a different one; do not add scores.
You have no write permission: print your answer in the response itself.
Write PLAIN TEXT, in exactly this shape:
CHANGE: <what you changed in the proposal> | <why the objection no longer applies>
UNCHANGED: <the part of the proposal you deliberately kept>
REMAINING: <the objection you accept and cannot repair>

Your session has no write tool and no shell: your reply IS the answer. Print the complete answer in exactly the format above, and print nothing else.

It is your only write: it appends one stage record to your own progress file, and nothing else can write there or read your file back as a verdict. Each record says the goal of the check, what you read, what you observed, where the evidence is, your short reasoning, and what is still open. Append a correction when you overturn an earlier conclusion. Append each result you produce as its own record as soon as you have it (one answer block per record), and append the complete answer as the last record: a task that ends early leaves the framework reading these records, so each one has to stand on its own.
